messages.subject: Project Mosaic - FairChain Series A term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Attached is the Series A term sheet for FairChain, agreed in principle with our client. The headline terms are GBP 4,000,000 for 2,000,000 Series A preference shares at GBP 2.00 (GBP 14m pre / GBP 18m post), 1x non-participating liquidation preference, a 12% enlarged option pool established pre-money, an Investor Director seat and observer, and customary reserved matters and information rights.

The binding provisions are clauses 1 to 6: confidentiality, 45-day exclusivity, a GBP 30,000 costs cap, governing law, and a lapse date of 5pm on 30 July. Grateful if Sophie could countersign this week so we can open the data room and hold the 30 September completion target.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Mosaic - FairChain Series A term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Sophie has signed the term sheet today - executed copy to follow from her. The commercial terms are agreed; our only reservations are for the long-form, where we'll want a sensible warranty package given the size of the round: a proportionate liability cap, a short claims period, and the IP warranties qualified by the founder's awareness rather than given flat. We can work through those constructively.

Data room access for your team will be set up tomorrow.

Regards,
Adam

Adam Selby | Partner | Denham Lewis LLP
